dedupe_keys.name: deliverable d4 6 performance and comparative analyses of landfill leachate treatment options for the removal of pfas

description: Todorova, Yovana and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed work compares membrane filtration, pyrolysis and plasma treatments at laboratory and pilot scales, including an Italian leachate plant. Reverse-osmosis permeate was below a twenty-ng/L quantification limit in the reported samples; this is not proof of zero PFAS. Pyrolysis and plasma outcomes vary with temperature, compounds and operating conditions. Some toxicity assays decrease after treatment, while one five-litre plasma experiment shows increased CALUX activity. Life-cycle assessment and cost analysis use site-specific energy information and retain uncertain PFAS health impacts. Companion mass-flow, adsorption and plasma reports belong to this bounded treatment programme. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
